target.title: test(qa): redact script evidence diagnostics
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The shared script evidence writer introduced by #99374 bounds logs and failure details, but it does not redact secret-bearing diagnostics or producer-known private values before persisting them. A truncation boundary can also retain a suffix of sensitive message content unless redaction happens before bounded output discards bytes.

## Why This Change Was Made

This follow-up reuses the existing logging redactor and adds producer-supplied sensitive values to `createQaScriptEvidenceWriter`. The writer removes exact sensitive values before generic masking, retains enough stream overlap to redact values split across child-process chunks, and only then applies the existing byte limits.

The focused contract tests cover credentials, access tokens, Matrix session keys, recovery material, private message content, chunk and byte-boundary splits, and native artifact content that claims a conflicting status.

## User Impact

There is no product behavior change. QA maintainers get bounded script evidence that does not persist known secret or private diagnostic content, while normalized pass/fail/blocked status remains controlled by the script result rather than native artifact payloads.

## Dependencies

- Stacked on #99374 because it extends the shared `createQaScriptEvidenceWriter` path added there.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/e2e/qa-lab/runtime/script-evidence.test.ts test/e2e/qa-lab/media/hosted-media-provider-live.test.ts test/e2e/qa-lab/plugins/clawhub-release-candidate-install.test.ts` — 31 tests passed.
- Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox `tbx_01kwmnd62c9p9edf2qzkqshmbt` — changed type, lint, guard, and import-cycle checks passed.
- Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox `tbx_01kwmnvdm6g1p6dtemz6ymc5t1` — exact-head `oxfmt --check` passed.
